latest.title: Sub-clipping in Vision Data Engineering Using MediaConvert
latest.description: In vision data engineering, we often need to sub-clip source videos with frame accuracy from multiple synchronized cameras. MediaConvert supports the so-called assembly workflow configuration which can be used to perform sub-clipping with frame accuracy. In this document we share certain design considerations and implementation details of such sub-clipping.
